## Purpose
Checks `/admin/cleanup`: every synthesised tool, finished job and generated document goes, while native tools and running jobs stay.

## Behaviour pinned down
Cleanup keeps the native tools and the running jobs.

## Fixtures, mocks and external dependencies
Rows inserted directly. The route handler is called through `routes.management`.

## How to run
`python -m pytest tests/test_cleanup_route.py -q`.

## Known gaps and flakiness
The documents-directory part depends on `/app/documents` existing.
